body:
I viewed the code and the call stack. I found out that the rename LineEdit is diffrent of the common LineEdit.
About the common LineEdit, after you click the position out of the LineEdit, Window::_window_input will be called. Then focus a new control.
About the rename LineEdit in the SceneTree, after you click the position out of the LineEdit, Window::hide() will be called. No focus process.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16f57df6-0cb9-4a9a-9656-296451b2afac)

The rename LineEdit hide effect is achieved by using Popup node. The rename LineEdit is the child of a Popup node. So if you leave any popup menu, you will get the same result of leaving rename LineEdit in SceneTree.
Like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/afc4058f-d601-475a-a866-816b4c6591a6)
